title: Pickleball's Easygoing Image Hides A $400 Million Injury Estimate
hook: Pickleball looks gentle, but its estimated injury bill reached $400 million.
closing: A casual-looking sport still needs preparation; a paddle does not make injuries harmless.
question: What surprised you when you first played?

segments.say: Pickleball participation reached 13.6 million Americans in the latest data. The player base more than quadrupled over the measured period.
Tennis had 23.6 million players in the comparison. Pickleball had already grown beyond half that audience.
Estimated pickleball injury costs reached $400 million in the supplied projection. Popularity brings medical costs as well as new players.
